latency_note: At SF1000, wall-clock is similar on both legs (~10 s end-to-end, ~0.9 s server data-time): BigQuery is massively parallel and its own result cache masks repeated reads. The acceleration win at a terabyte is cost (bytes scanned), not latency — so this page leads with cost and data scanned, not a latency chart.
